import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    m_input = int(input_data[0])
    k_input = int(input_data[1])
    m = m_input
    k = k_input

    baseDigits = []
    while m:
        baseDigits.append(m % k)
        m //=k

    n = k + 1
    P = 10**9 + 7

    class Matrix:
        def __init__(self):
            self.t = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
        def identity(self):
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    self.t[i][j] = 1 if i == j else 0
        def multiply(self, b):
            result = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    for k_ in range(n):
                        result[i][k_] += self.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k_]
                        result[i][k_] %= P
            self.t = result

    baseMatrix = Matrix()
    for i in range(k):
        baseMatrix.t[i][(i+1)%k] = 1
    baseMatrix.t[k][k] = 1

    identityMatrix = Matrix()
    identityMatrix.identity()

    for i in range(k+1):
        baseMatrix.t[0][i] = 1
        baseMatrix.t[i][i] = 1

    d = [Matrix() for _ in range(len(baseDigits))]
    d[0] = identityMatrix
    d[0].multiply(baseMatrix)

    for i in range(1, len(baseDigits)):
        d[i] = Matrix()
        d[i].t = [row[:] for row in d[i-1].t]
        for _ in range(k):
            d[i].multiply(d[i])
        d[i].multiply(baseMatrix)

    result = [1]*(n)

    for idx in range(len(baseDigits)-1, -1, -1):
        for _ in range(baseDigits[idx]):
            power = [0]*n
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    power[j] += result[i] * d[idx].t[i][j]
                    power[j] %= P
            result = power

    print(result[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
